We are looking for a Senior Product Designer passionate about building innovative digital products

(We’re also open for an ambitious mid-level)

On-site position in CPH. No remote or hybrid.

Signifly is a digital agency with digital products and experiences at heart. We’ve helped shape many of the digital products and experiences used by Danes every day. From apps and e-commerce to websites and digital services.

As a Product Designer in Copenhagen, you’ll work alongside designers and developers to create best-in-class digital experiences for ambitious start-ups and established enterprises.

At Signifly, we are a team so besides working with the rest of the design team, you will also be working with Consultants and strategists to understand the strategic and business objectives as they relate to the product experience.

What you’ll be working on

• 
Widely used products. Define and design digital products and experiences used by a large audience across Denmark.

• 
Complex digital products. Design best-in-class apps, interfaces, services, websites, tools etc. for varied industries such as B2B, fintech, medtech, government, start-ups etc.

• 
Understand complex, Deliver simple: Turn complex workflows, systems, and requirements into intuitive and effortless user experiences.

• 
Strategic execution. Understand user journeys, ideate during discovery, and deliver final designs with a strong UX foundation.

• 
Deliver from start to finish. Own the quality and delivery of all phases from early research phase to final high fidelity UI delivery.

• 
Design for real users. Plan and participate in research, synthesize insights, and turn user needs and behaviours into meaningful product decisions.

• 
Help shape how we build with AI. We expect you to be actively exploring the frontier of design and AI and possible tools. Use AI in your work and help explore and define how AI can improve how we research, design, prototype, and ship products.

• 
Create best-in-class UI. Craft polished and intuitive interfaces that balance usability, visual quality, accessibility and business goals.

• 
Take ownership. Take responsibility for the quality of the customer journey, actively seek feedback, and know when and how to bring others into the process.

Job requirements

What we expect from you

• 
Complex digital products. Experience designing SaaS, B2B, enterprise, data-heavy, or workflow-driven products where simplicity is key.

• 
Startup environments. Experience navigating ambiguity, moving quickly, taking ownership, and balancing creative ambition with the realities of delivery.

• 
AI-enabled products. Experience designing AI-powered experiences or working confidently with emerging AI interaction patterns and workflows.

• 
Design systems. Experience building, evolving, or contributing to scalable component libraries, tokens, patterns, and documentation.

• 
Rapid prototyping. Confident using tools such as Figma, Framer, code, or AI prototyping tools to quickly turn ideas into realistic, testable experiences.

• 
Flexible and multidisciplinary. Experience working across different industries like e-commerce, fintech, healthcare, SaaS, lifestyle, mobility etc.. And across changing platforms like native apps, services, platforms, kiosks etc.

• 
Cross-functional facilitation. Experience running workshops, presenting design rationale, navigating stakeholder feedback, and creating alignment across Product, Engineering, and business teams.

Please expect from us

The most important thing that we offer is an inspiring and ambitious work environment, with an emphasis on learning and developing, both personally and as a team. We have an informal organization with minimal hierarchy, where there is plenty of room for being ambitious within your own area of expertise, as well as taking part in shaping our team, culture, and product offering.

But, of course, we can also tempt you with:

• 
Yearly one-week team trip with both social and professional focuses (paid)

• 
Fresh catered lunch of mostly organic produce and with vegetarian options

• 
Coffee, tea, soft drinks, snacks, etc. day and night

• 
Beautiful office space with emphasis noise reduction, centrally located in Vesterbro

• 
Paid equipment of high quality - you choose what you prefer

• 
In-office massage service

• 
Voluntary sports activities including Company Soccer & E-Sports league.

• 
Inspiration-trips to events, meet-ups, and conferences

• 
Company paid pension and health insurance

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance

• 
Career progress based on merits rather than seniority

• 
Opportunity to work-exchange with our office in Montreal or London

About Signifly

At Signifly, we collaborate with a broad range of clients from all industries, to create new and innovative digital products and business models. We are a team of developers, designers, film makers and digital strategists, and we believe that creativity, entrepreneurship and a diverse mix of top-notch skills can drive the innovation and change that will help shape a better tomorrow. For further information about the position, please contact Søren Schrøder (Head of Design) at ss@signifly.com.

Checkout our work at Signifly.com.

We are looking for a Senior Strategist (Brand/Comms)

Hi there,

We’re looking for a Senior Strategist (Brand, Comms) to help shape and strengthen the brands of tomorrow. You’ll work closely with world-class designers, creatives, developers, and consultants to turn insights into strategy and strategy into action.

Danish proficiency is a plus (but not a must) for this role.

What you’ll be doing:

• 
Research & Insights: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research (e.g., stakeholder interviews, workshops, market research, trend analysis, and data interpretation).

• 
Brand Strategy & Positioning: Develop brand platforms, incl. core narratives, positioning, and messaging frameworks that drive brand-led business.

• 
Communication & Content Strategy: Craft brand-led communication strategies, key messaging, and storytelling approaches.

• 
Strategy in Action: Move seamlessly from strategic thinking to execution by shaping campaign plans, content, messaging, and activations that create measurable impact.

• 
Business Impact: Connect brand and communication initiatives to business objectives, customer needs, and measurable outcomes.

• 
Collaboration & Execution: Work closely with designers, creatives, and strategists to ensure brand vision is executed effectively.

• 
Client & Project Leadership: Manage multiple brand and communication projects, maintain strong client relationships, and present insights and recommendations.

• 
Adept copywriting skills in both Danish and English are key - you know how to craft compelling narratives and articulate strategic thinking clearly.

We don’t expect you to tick every single box, but the more, the better - and we value potential just as much as experience.

Job requirements

What we expect from you:

• 
A strong understanding of brand-building, communication strategy, and storytelling.

• 
A track record in crafting compelling narratives and brand platforms.

• 
The ability to combine creative exploration with analytical and structured thinking, and to translate your findings into crisp recommendations and strategic guidance for clients.

• 
Leadership skills - you naturally guide projects, support junior colleagues, and help grow the brand and comms function at Signifly.

• 
A collaborative mindset - you work well across teams and communicate effectively.

• 
You’re comfortable using emerging tools and technologies, including AI, to accelerate research, sharpen thinking, and improve execution.

Your background

• 
3+ years of experience in brand strategy, communications, or marketing (agency, consultancy, or client-side).

• 
A relevant academic background - or a strong track record proving your skills.

What you can expect from us

We offer an ambitious yet down-to-earth work environment with a focus on learning, collaboration, and personal growth.

Plus, a few perks:

• 
Annual, paid team trip (Italy, Portugal, and Copenhagen in past years).

• 
Fresh catered lunch (mostly organic, vegetarian options available).

• 
Unlimited snacks & drinks (including Friday wine & beers).

• 
Beautiful office at Vesterbro Torv.

• 
High-quality equipment - you choose what you prefer.

• 
In-office massage service.

• 
Paid inspiration trips (events, meetups, conferences).

• 
Company-paid pension and health insurance.

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and performance.

• 
Merit-based career progression - your impact matters more than seniority.

• 
Work-exchange opportunities in Montreal, Toronto, or London.

And if something’s missing? Let us know.

**

About Signifly**

We create brands and digital experiences that delight people and drive business. We’ve been at it for over 10 years, and our awards say we’re doing a decent job. Our clients range from FMCG to SaaS, spanning startups, scale-ups, and global companies. In our Copenhagen office, we’re a team of 50+ strategists, designers, developers, PMs, and creatives - working together to push boundaries and have fun doing it.

For further information about the position, please contact Mathias Rønnow, Head of Strategy, at mr@signifly.com.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Role

We are seeking an experienced SAP Manager, Sales and Distribution (SD), to lead and support SAP initiatives across Order-to-Cash (OTC) and logistics business processes. The ideal candidate will bring strong SAP S/4HANA experience, deep functional expertise in SAP SD and logistics, and an understanding of end-to-end OTC processes within the life sciences industry. The successful candidate will have participated in at least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation and be adept at translating business needs into scalable, sustainable solutions.

This role is responsible for solution design, implementation, process optimization, stakeholder management, and ongoing operational support. Working closely with Finance, Corporate Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, DD&AI, Business COE, affiliates, and external partners, the SAP Manager will drive SAP best practices and facilitate cross-functional decisions aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards, and Genmab’s SAP S/4HANA roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

SAP SD Solution & Delivery

• Lead SAP SD and logistics design, configuration, implementation, enhancement, and support across S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, and rollouts.

• Provide functional expertise across end-to-end OTC processes, including sales order management, pricing, availability checking, delivery, shipping and transportation, billing, returns, credit/debit processing, and credit management.

• Support customer and business partner master data, intercompany transactions, and third-party sales scenarios.

• Manage process integration between SAP SD, MM, FI/CO, EWM/WM, TM, and external systems.

• Translate business requirements into scalable solutions through fit-to-standard/fit-gap analysis, prioritizing standard S/4HANA capabilities and minimizing unnecessary customization.

• Advise on S/4HANA simplifications and process changes affecting SD and logistics.

• Coordinate functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.

• Maintain documentation of requirements, functional designs, configurations, test scenarios, and operating procedures.

• Oversee production support, resolve complex issues, and drive root-cause analysis and permanent solutions for recurring problems.

• Ensure solutions comply with Genmab policies, internal controls, and audit expectations; support audits and timely remediation of findings

Business & Stakeholder Management

• Facilitate requirements workshops, identify process improvements, prioritize enhancements, and support solution decisions and adoption.

• Optimize order fulfillment, delivery, and shipping across internal operations and external logistics partners.

• Align billing, credit management, intercompany transactions, and financial integration with accounting processes and control requirements.

• Coordinate architecture and design reviews, interfaces, APIs, enhancements, reports, forms, and workflows, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and the SAP roadmap.

• Communicate SAP concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and manage expectations, priorities, dependencies, risks, and issues across initiatives.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is a plus.

• 8+ years of SAP SD and logistics experience, including 3+ years with SAP S/4HANA.

• Participation in at least one full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation, from requirements through stabilization; experience leading an SD or logistics workstream preferred.

• Strong hands-on expertise in SAP SD, end-to-end Order-to-Cash, and related logistics and supply chain processes.

• Experience integrating SAP SD with MM, FI/CO, EWM/WM, and TM; broader experience with EWM, TM, or GTS preferred.

• Experience with SAP configuration, functional specifications, testing, data migration, cutover, and production support.

• Working knowledge of SAP Fiori and S/4HANA capabilities; relevant SAP certification preferred.

• Experience integrating SAP with 3PLs, warehouse systems, transportation providers, or customer platforms, and familiarity with APIs, IDocs, EDI, and middleware preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business and technology teams; experience managing implementation partners and managed service providers preferred.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a complex enterprise environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills, with a focus on sustainable solutions and continuous improvement.

• Life sciences experience and knowledge of commercialization and supply chain processes preferred, along with experience supporting global SAP deployments.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK563.040,00---844.560,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Design for the people in the tiny chairs

At Famly, we build software that takes admin off the plates of early-years educators, so they can spend their time where it matters - with the children. And we make it easier for over a million parents to stay close to their child's day, even while they're at work.

We're looking for a design system builder to join the design team - responsible for the design system, prototyping tools and all other infrastructure with the goal of driving consistency and coherence across the entire product.

About Famly

We’re on a mission to stop admin stealing the joy of working with young children. We do that with our platform, the world’s first proactive assistant for educators and staff that handles admin for them so they can get back to what they love. And we do it with our content (like The Tiny Chair Podcast), reminding educators of the joy and meaning that got them into working with children in the first place.

About the role

You live where design and code meet. With a small team, you'll own Famly's design system: the components, patterns, and documentation that product teams (and increasingly, AI agents) build on every day.

The team's job is coherence. Every feature and every domain should feel like it came from the same place. You'll give builders what they need to design and build to our standards, and keep the conversation going so the system keeps getting better.

You'll bring deep technical knowledge of design systems, and you'll care just as much about how the product feels to the people using it.

The team is based in our Copenhagen office, but we are open to you being based somewhere else.

What you'll be doing

• 
Build production-quality React and TypeScript components for Famly's design system.

• 
Design component APIs that are hard to misuse, and version them so upgrades don't break product teams.

• 
Write the documentation that makes those components self-serve, so a new engineer or an AI agent can pick one up and use it correctly without asking anyone.

• 
Keep the system trustworthy: tests, visual regression, and a release process people don't dread.

• 
Learn Famly's frontend deeply enough to know where a pattern lives, who depends on it, and what breaks if it changes.

• 
Audit and evolve the components we already have, for consistency, accessibility, and reuse across the product.

• 
Own the code side of the design standard with a small team, so design intent survives the trip into production.

• 
Push back when a design won't hold up in code - too many states, no empty case, a pattern that already exists - and say what you'd do instead.

• 
Work with PMs, designers, and engineers across product teams, and bring them ideas before they ask.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

• 
You have 5+ years of frontend experience in B2B SaaS, including design system work.

• 
You're strong in React, TypeScript, and CSS.

• 
You have taste for craft: spacing, motion, states, and the details that make a component feel finished.

• 
You think in systems: reusable, documented, maintainable components over one-off fixes.

• 
You get from a rough idea to a working prototype fast.

• 
You own your work end to end, from discovery through testing to shipping.

• 
You care about the difference between "works" and "is right," and you'll say so and set the direction.

The interview process looks like:

• 
Short meet and greet with Lead People Partner

• 
A logical test

• 
1st interview: Meet and greet with our Senior Director of Product Design

• 
Take-home assignment

• 
2nd interview: Assignment presentation with Senior Director of Product Design and Lead Designer

And who are Famly?

You’re probably wondering at this stage, and Famly are...? Well, it all began when our co-founder Henrik’s daughter was ready to start at daycare. He couldn’t believe the amount of work being done on paper - and how distant he felt from his first child during the day. The paper ‘parent’ books they exchanged once a month just weren’t cutting it. Together with his friend, our co-founder and CEO Anders, they set about solving that.

These days, about 180 of us build Famly for more than 10,000 institutions and over 1 million parents.

We handle admin stress so they can get back to what matters, and we make it easier than ever to connect home, and nursery so parents can play a part in their child’s day. If you join us, you’ll be building, selling, or support customers with everything from staff rotas and invoices, to child development and parent communication.

How we work

Famly prides itself on a few principles; we choose simplicity, we believe friendliness is a superpower, we set the pace, and we want everyone to be surrounded by talent.

It all adds up to a culture that refuses to make employees choose between a place that is ambitious and sets the pace for what good looks like - and one that is a nice place to work. We think you can be ambitious and kind and when you get to meet our team, we hope you’ll agree.

What we expect of you, is that you make others shine, that you believe in being better than yesterday, and you are not afraid to just ‘get it done’. Finally, we want you to value ‘sitting in the tiny chair’ - which means you look at your work through the impact it has on our customers: the people sitting in tiny chairs in childcare settings all over the world.

What’s in it for you?

• 
Competitive pension, private health insurance, and paid maternity/paternity leave.

• 
A clear career framework and coaching to make sure you’re growing, a $1000 personal development budget and a ‘We’ll buy you any book you want’ policy.

• 
We guarantee we’ll create the time, space and leadership (as well as the budget) to make sure you grow and develop.

• 
We want to set the pace, and don't cut corners when it comes to investing in tooling and technology that you need to be at the frontier of tech.

• 
We’re all about hiring clever people who are good humans too. It means Famly is full of top thinkers and generous teammates waiting to help you shine.

• 
We like to give a lot of ownership both in terms of responsibility and freedom to try new, challenging tasks.

• 
Top-notch work equipment (including noise cancelling headphones for those focus periods!).

• 
We believe collaboration happens best in person, so we have the default of four days a week in office - but with plenty of flexibility for when life happens outside the office too.

We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible, so get your application in today by sending us:

• 
Your CV

• 
Short and precise cover letter to tell us what you can bring to the role

• 
Portfolio (attached or linked) showcasing your work

Looking forward to hearing from you!

The inside scoop on Famly

Wanna get to know Famly even better? Then have a look at our website to learn more about:

• 
our product and our mission

• 
our company and who we are

• 
our company values

•

Want to get know more about how we work in Famly?

jobs.description:
We are looking for a jewellery design intern to support us with design and production.

longvé is a dynamic and innovative jewellery start-up located in the heart of Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv. We offer a fresh digital approach to the jewellery industry, with our digital platform empowering customers to design their own jewellery. We offer the customers classic customisable designs, handcrafted quality and sustainable sourcing of recycled materials, all at a transparent and fair price. The company launched at the end of 2022.

We are currently seeking an intern jewellery designer. This is a unique opportunity to impact a newly launched brand, and get a steep learning curve, while working in a high-paced start-up environment, where we make sure to have fun.

Besides being enrolled in a study program within jewellery design, fashion design or something similar, the ideal candidate should have:

• Experience in Rhino software

• Knowledge of rendering in Keyshot is an advantage.

• Skilled in ideation and sketching.

• Responsibility to meet deadlines and take ownership of the project.

• Ability to work independently in a high-paced start-up environment.

• Willingness to be a part of something new and exciting.

**

What you will do:**

As an intern, you will help develop new jewellery styles and collections by sketching new designs, and drawing up designs in Rhino. You will also have the opportunity to work with our partners for translating the designs into the hands of our craftsmen, as well as preparing the right quality image material for frontline sales and marketing use.

What you get:

• Hands-on experience with building a new jewellery brand

• Insights into and experience with the start-up world

• Possibility to build up portfolio material

• Autonomous working schedule where you can influence ways of working

• Working closely with the founders and joining a team that values great energy, good humour and strong collaboration

The start date and length of the internship will be agreed with the selected candidate. The internship may lead to a potential job opportunity based on the fit, skills, and growth of the business.

We promise to give you hands-on experience as well as an exciting playground for you to test, develop and execute great ideas. If you find this an exciting opportunity, please send your CV and resume, with some examples you have done, and the style you like personally. Send to Katja Schjølin at katja@longve.com.

Then join us as our new Senior Software Engineer

Join BEUMER Group and Shape the Future of Airport Security
The global aviation industry is facing increasing demands for security, operational efficiency, and passenger experience. SECTRO is BEUMER Group’s strategic response to these challenges, combining advanced automation, intelligent system integration, and scalable software solutions to create the future of airport security screening. As SECTRO continues its transition from development into industrialization and execution, software has become a critical success factor in delivering a standardized, configurable, and globally scalable product portfolio.

You will be part of a global and cross-functional engineering setup, collaborating closely with software, automation, and system engineers, as well as external partners and suppliers.

• 
Act as the technical focal point and subject matter expert for HLC solutions across the SECTRO product portfolio.

• 
Maintain the overall overview of the HLC landscape, ensuring consistency, standardization, and scalability across projects.

•

Technology Stack

•

• 
Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.

• 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• 
A proactive mindset with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

You are fluent both in both written and spoken English.

Interested?
If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact TPO & Team Manager, SECTRO Christian Kjer Elkjær at +45 3176 7183 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Vestergaard Holm at +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group
Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

•

•

•

• 
Flexible working hours and the choice of operating from a remote office are important components of our modern work culture, much like our bright, spacious offices and ergonomically optimized workstations.

•

•

•

•

•

•

•

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer | North Aquaculture · Grindsted, Denmark
jobs.description:
We aim to strengthen our Engineering Department and are therefore seeking a Project Engineer. You will receive training in RAS (Recirculating Aquaculture System) design and engineering, including pressure loss calculations, pipe system dimensioning, quality control of mechanical equipment such as pumps and heaters/chillers, sizing of water treatment facilities, creation and coordination of drawings, P&ID’s, and other technical project documents.

As a Project Engineer, we are looking for a systematic, detail-oriented, and self-motivated individual who enjoys working on problem-solving. You will receive training and guidance, but we expect you to take initiative and take ownership of your daily tasks.

Main responsibilities:

• Create and maintain design & engineering deliverables throughout the project life cycle.

• Coordinate and evaluate technical documentation and system descriptions.

• Collaborate with our design, project and sales team

• Consult with customer, project group and subcontractors.

• Dimensioning and calculation of water treatment system, piping systems and RAS-equipment.

• The role will involve some traveling to our clients and RAS facilities.

jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Natural Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Physics and Astronomy programme. The position is available from February 2027 or later.

Research area and project description:

The Department of Physics and Astronomy, Aarhus University, invites applications for a PhD position, starting February 1st, 2027, offering applicants an exciting opportunity to join a new research project on orbitronics and metastable states in two-dimensional quantum materials.

The project involves fabrication of devices and their integration with the existing angle-resolved photoemission (ARPES) infrastructure at the ASTRID2 light source to discover quantum geometric effects and their link to new forms of transport phenomena.

The aim of the project is to develop new types of 2D material devices that can realize orbital, spin and valley Hall effects that form the basis for prototypical memory devices. A series of novel infrastructures will be applied to achieve these goals, including semi-automated fabrication systems in inert environments, clean-room facilities for device production, micro-focused synchrotron light for ARPES characterization at ASTRID2 as well as ultrafast femtosecond laser pulses for optical control of the materials.

The major activities include:

• Design and manufacturing of advanced 2D devices that are compatible with the microARPES experiment at ASTRID2 with the specific aim to uncover orbital-driven phenomena in materials.

• Combining synchrotron and ultrafast laser sources to visualize, excite and control electronic states with distinct orbital and spin textures in quantum materials.

• Isolation, twisting and stacking of monolayer metallic and semiconducting transition metal dichalcogenide, including materials that are sensitive to ambient conditions.

• Development of new techniques to isolate and integrate such air-sensitive materials with devices for photoemission experiments carried out in UHV conditions.

• Applying a state-of-the-art laser beamline integrated with the ASTRID2 synchrotron light source for femtosecond control of electronic structure of 2D materials.

jobs.occupation: Quantum Control of Emission in Valleytronic Materials
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Natural Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Physics and Astronomy programme. The position is available from February 2027 or later.

Research area and project description:

We are seeking a candidate for a fully funded 3-year PhD project at the Department of Physics and Astronomy, Aarhus University, in the new group of Asst. Prof. Christian Frydendahl, as part of a DFF Sapere Aude research grant.

Compact, integrable sources of circularly polarized light (CPL) are a key enabling technology for chip-scale quantum technologies, but electrically driven sources of pure CPL do not yet exist. Monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) emit left- or right-handed CPL depending on which band structure valley, K or K', an electron-hole pair recombines in. Ordinarily, this occurs with an equal 50/50 split between the two valleys.

This project aims to build a new light-emitting diode geometry in which the Valley Hall effect, another intrinsic property of these materials, filters the valley index of the charge carriers during transport, enabling a purely electrically pumped source of CPL. Inducing valley polarization electrically rather than optically is one of the key open challenges in the emerging field of device-based valleytronics.

The project also includes a planned 6-month external research stay at the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), where you will develop and fabricate nanophotonic cavities for integration with the new diode design, enhancing its emission and CPL purity further via the Purcell effect.

Your general working tasks would be:

• van der Waals stacking of hBN-encapsulated TMDC monolayers

• Nanofabrication in the AU/SUTD cleanroom facilities (EBL, RIE, metal deposition)

• Opto-electronic characterization: probe station, polarization- and time-resolved spectroscopy at room- and cryogenic temperatures

• Publishing results and presenting at international conferences
